description: EFGH 8-K/A: Amendment — $500K remaining, 12% discount, 5-day lookback, floor $0.18, no resets

financingType.note: Text: 'Convertible Promissory Note' — amendment to existing note

discountRate.note: Text: '88% of the lowest VWAP during the 5 trading days'. Discount = 1 - 0.88 = 0.12

lookbackDays.note: Text: '5 trading days immediately preceding the conversion date'

hasFloorPrice.note: Text: 'subject to a floor conversion price of $0.18 per share'

floorPrice.note: Text: 'floor conversion price of $0.18 per share' and 'conversion price shall not be less than $0.18'

hasResetProvisions.note: Text: 'Note does not contain anti-dilution reset provisions. No adjustment to the conversion price will occur based on subsequent issuances'

principalAmount.note: Text: 'remaining principal balance of the Note is $500,000'. Parser may read this as principal amount of the amendment or as the total original note. Domain verification needed.

investorName.note: Text: 'Silverton Funding Partners LLC (the "Holder")'. Extraction depends on investor name parser patterns.
